**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Terminate owned descendants on Windows**

On Windows, an owned launcher that spawns a descendant is stopped with `child.kill(signal)`, while `ownedGroupAlive` also checks only the launcher's exit state. Once the launcher exits, `stopChild` therefore reports successful cleanup even if its descendant is still running; the HTTP regression runners can then remove their temporary state while a Wrangler/workerd child still holds files or ports. Use a Windows process-tree mechanism such as a job object or an equivalent tree termination path rather than killing only the direct child.
